name: Lupin
about: Lupin Ltd. is a globally recognized pharmaceutical company, known for its expertise in manufacturing generic and branded formulations, biosimilars, and active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs). With a strong presence across key therapeutic areas such as cardiology, respiratory, diabetes, and central nervous system disorders, Lupin serves millions of patients worldwide. The company focuses on innovation, research, and development, continuously expanding its portfolio with new treatments and therapies. Lupin operates state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities and is highly compliant with international regulatory standards. Its commitment to providing affordable healthcare solutions has made it one of the top pharmaceutical companies in both developed and emerging markets.
